<function name="RemoveAllDecals" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Removes all decals from the entities surface.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Removes all decals from all props in world.</description>
	<code>
for i, ent in ipairs( ents.FindByClass( "prop_physics" ) ) do
	ent:RemoveAllDecals()
end
	</code>

</example>
